title: Eufy robo vacuum spare parts
text: Eufy robo vacuum spare parts. Purchased these parts for my niece when I gifted her the Eufy robo vac 11s.  They were well received and I am sure she will use them.

product_metadata.title: Replacement Parts Accessories Kit for Eufy RoboVac 11S, 15C, 30, 30C, 12, 35C Vacuum Filters, 10 Side Brushes, 8 Filter, 1 Pre Filter, 1 Roller Brush Guard
features: 🌱Well Fit – Working great fit for Eufy RoboVac 11S, 30, 30C, 15C, 12, 35C ( 📢Not Fit for Robovac 11, 11C, 11+ & Max Series)
🌱 Replacement Parts Design - 10 pcs side brushes + 8 pcs filters + 1 roller brush + 1 pre filter + 1 roller brush guard + 2 cleaning tools. Get a full kit.
🌱 High Performance, More Effective - Powerful & quiet rolling brush help to extend the service life of your 11s vac.
🌱Quality Above All Else - Made of great materials, this replacement parts kit for eufy 11s robovac is designed to outlast for years to come
🌱Easy to Install – Free your hands from the complicated replacement steps. No extra tools needed. Changing the replenishment kit every 2~3 months
